question: What material gains may even an unaccomplished practitioner obtain?
premises: He obtains an octad of gold.
He obtains an octad of silver.
inference: Even an unaccomplished practitioner obtains eight units of gold and eight of silver.
uncertainties: Exact measure denoted by aṣṭakam is context-dependent.
plain_english: Indeed, even an unaccomplished person obtains eight units of gold and eight units of silver.
